\section{Differentiated image tails}\label{app:image-tails}

For $a>0$, define
\[
F_{a,t}(\theta)=e^{-a^2/(2t)}
\left[\cosh\frac{a\theta}{t}
-\frac{a^2}{t}\int_0^1\cosh\frac{sa\theta}{t}\dd s\right].
\]
The hyperbolic function in the $m$th derivative is either a sine-hyperbolic
or cosine-hyperbolic function.  On $0\le\theta\le\rho$ its absolute value is
at most $e^{a\rho/t}$, and therefore
\begin{equation}\label{eq:Fa-bound}
\abs{\partial_\theta^mF_{a,t}(\theta)}
\le e^{-a^2/(2t)+a\rho/t}\left(\frac at\right)^m
\left(1+\frac{a^2}{t(m+1)}\right).
\end{equation}
The integrand and all derivatives have a summable Gaussian majorant, so
derivative interchange is valid at every finite order.

For $A=a^2/2-a\rho>0$, the logarithmic derivative with respect to $t$ of
$e^{-A/t}t^{-m}(1+c/t)$ is bounded below by
\[
\frac{A}{t^2}-\frac{m+1}{t}.
\]
It is nonnegative for $t\le A/(m+1)$.  This proves the time-monotonicity used
in Theorem~\ref{thm:image-hierarchy}.

Let $T_{m,k}$ be twice the right side of \eqref{eq:Fa-bound} at
$a=2\pi k$ and $t=t_0$.  Since
\[
\frac{1+c(k+1)^2}{1+ck^2}\le\left(\frac{k+1}{k}\right)^2,
\]
we obtain
\[
\frac{T_{m,k+1}}{T_{m,k}}
\le\left(\frac{k+1}{k}\right)^{m+2}
e^{-[2\pi^2(2k+1)-2\pi\rho]/t_0}.
\]
The right side decreases with $k$.  If $N$ is the first omitted index and
$r_{m,N}<1$, summing the geometric majorant gives
\[
\sum_{k\ge N}T_{m,k}\le\frac{T_{m,N}}{1-r_{m,N}}.
\]
